SIGN_IN_TITLE: Sign in to the Platform Console
SIGN_IN_DESCRIPTION: Use your Arclayer identity, then complete Platform security verification.
CREDENTIALS_DESCRIPTION: Your Product Application session is not used here.
SECURITY_KEY_SETUP_DESCRIPTION: Add a security key or passkey before entering the Platform Console.
ADD_SECURITY_KEY_TO_CONTINUE: Add a security key or passkey
USE_SECURITY_KEY_OR_PASSKEY: Use a security key or passkey
AUTHENTICATOR_APP_SETUP_REQUIRED: Set up an authenticator app to protect Platform access on this account.
AUTHENTICATOR_SETUP_DESCRIPTION: Add this secret to your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
VERIFICATION_CODE_DESCRIPTION: Enter the current code from your authenticator app.
VERIFICATION_CODE_RETRY: Check the current code and try again.
RECOVERY_CODES_DESCRIPTION: Each code works once if you lose access to your authenticator app. They will not be shown again.
RECOVERY_CODES_SAVED_CONFIRMATION: I saved these recovery codes in a secure place.
ERROR_TITLE: Access information could not be loaded
ERROR_DESCRIPTION: The Console could not confirm the current Platform state.
PERMISSION_TITLE: This Platform account cannot view this information
PERMISSION_DESCRIPTION: Ask the Instance Owner or an authorized Platform Operator for access.
EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: The server returned no records for this view.
READ_ONLY_DESCRIPTION: This Console build can read the current server-confirmed state. Changes are not available until their complete secure workflow is available.
TEAM_DESCRIPTION: Review the Instance Owner, Platform Operators, and invitations that are waiting or no longer effective.
OWNER_DESCRIPTION: One person holds this non-delegable responsibility.
OPERATORS_DESCRIPTION: Current access status, role coverage, security readiness, and device activity.
INVITATIONS_DESCRIPTION: Review pending invitations and those that are no longer effective.
INVITATION_DESCRIPTION: Review the identity, role outcome, and current invitation status.
ROLES_DESCRIPTION: Review the reusable role catalog and its current responsibilities.
ROLE_CATALOG_DESCRIPTION: Role changes are unavailable until their reviewed workflow is available.
PERMISSION_CATALOG_DESCRIPTION: Descriptions come from the server-owned catalog.
SIGN_IN_READINESS_DESCRIPTION: Review the current registration policy and identity-provider readiness.
IDENTITY_PROVIDERS_DESCRIPTION: Installed providers and their current configuration state.
SESSIONS_DESCRIPTION: Review this account’s verified security methods and active Platform devices.
MFA_DESCRIPTION: Only safe method labels and verification status are shown.
MFA_EMPTY: No verified security methods are available.
DEVICE_SESSIONS_DESCRIPTION: Current device sessions are shown without token or fingerprint details.
SESSIONS_EMPTY: No active Platform sessions are recorded.
